failure.message: this identity cannot create namespaces, customresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.k8s.io, clusterroles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io, clusterrolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io, applicationsets.argoproj.io: the bootstrap stops at the first object it applies and nothing installs

testcase.failure: namespaces — every Application syncs with CreateNamespace=true customresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.k8s.io — Dapr, cert-manager, CNPG and ArgoCD each register CRDs clusterroles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io — the bundled operators install cluster-scoped RBAC clusterrolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io — the bundled operators bind that RBAC to their ServiceAccounts applicationsets.argoproj.io — the install is two ApplicationSets applied by hand bind the install identity to a role that grants them — for a POC, `kubectl create clusterrolebinding budctl-installer --clusterrole=cluster-admin --user=<identity>`; for a scoped role, grant create on namespaces, customresourcedefinitions, clusterroles, clusterrolebindings and applicationsets.argoproj.io

testcase.name: components.dns

failure.message: no CoreDNS or kube-dns pods in kube-system: nothing in the cluster can resolve a Service name, so every Dapr service-invocation hop, database connection and object-store call fails

testcase.failure: install the distribution's DNS addon before installing Bud — no chart in either ApplicationSet provides cluster DNS. On kubeadm it arrives with the CNI manifest; on k3s and managed distributions it is present by default, so its absence means the addon was disabled or removed.

testcase.name: components.ingress

failure.message: no IngressClass exists: every Ingress the install creates stays unclaimed, so not one hostname the chart publishes is ever reachable

testcase.failure: install an ingress controller before applying the ApplicationSets — neither of them provides one. Any controller is acceptable: `helm install ingress-nginx ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx -n ingress-nginx --create-namespace`, k3s's bundled Traefik, or the cloud provider's. Then set ingress.className to its class, or mark the class default with the `ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: "true"` annotation.

testcase.name: components.metrics-server

failure.message: the v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io APIService exists but is not Available (seeded): the aggregation layer cannot reach it, so every HPA in the chart reads `<unknown>/70%` and never scales

testcase.failure: backing service: local (served by the API server itself) install metrics-server — no chart in either ApplicationSet does: `kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/latest/download/components.yaml`, adding `--kubelet-insecure-tls` to its args on clusters whose kubelets serve self-signed certificates
